The domain of the vector-valued function f(t)=(t+1)2i+cos⁡tj+sec⁡(2t)k is t∈(−∞,∞),t≠AAAAA. What is the missing expression? You may assume that n is an integer.

a
π2+2πn
b
πn4
c
π4+πn
d
π2+πn
e
π4+πn2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To find the domain of f, we need the intersection of the domains of the individual components.

  • The domain of the 1st component (t+1)2 is t∈(−∞,∞).

  • The domain of the 2nd component cos⁡t is t∈(−∞,∞),

  • The domain of the 3rd component sec⁡(2t) is t∈(−∞,∞), except for the values of t for which 2t=π2+πn⟹t=π4+πn2, where n is an integer.

Therefore, the domain of the vector-valued function f(t) is t∈(−∞,∞),t≠π4+πn2, where n is an integer.
